notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control can tapping them, adding at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Zacama.
Zacama dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Zacama to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's abilities.
